title: Generic Quantum-Secure Key-Length Extension
summary: Cipher-specific key expansion requires internal knowledge; a generic method achieving full key-length security against quantum adversaries with minimal overhead remains open.

formal_statement.body: Increasing a cipher's key size through cipher-specific internal modifications requires exact knowledge of its internal behavior. Construct a generic key-length extension that, given a cipher with an $m$-bit key, produces a cipher achieving $m$-bit security against quantum adversaries while incurring only a minimal performance penalty.

scope.domain: Generic key-length extension for symmetric block ciphers against quantum adversaries.
parameters: m: bit length of the input cipher's key and the target security level against quantum adversaries
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct a generic key-length extension achieving m-bit security against quantum adversaries with only a minimal performance penalty.

citations.label: Grover Meets Simon - Quantumly Attacking the FX-construction

progress.summary: The source explicitly presents this as a future research question and says related work offers only initial ideas. It does not provide the requested generic extension.
